task_instance: Publish one AGENCY Community meetup Zoom recording end-to-end to YouTube: download the Zoom MP4+VTT, prepend the intro, generate timecodes and description, render a thumbnail, upload the video publicly, set the thumbnail, and add it to the AGENCY Community playlist.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is bounded by two account-bound external services and a public write that the safety rules forbid. Step 1-2 require authenticated access to a video-conferencing account (an OAuth credential store and a bundled meetings script) to even locate and download the source recording; no recording can be obtained without that account. Steps 7-9 require an authenticated video-platform account and perform a public upload plus playlist/thumbnail writes to that external service, which the safety rules prohibit (no account-bound services, no credentials, no public deployment, no external writes). Independently, every bundled dependency named in Prerequisites is absent from this runtime: the conferencing-skill scripts directory, the uploader project with its upload/manage scripts, and the intro animation MP4 do not exist, and no browser is installed for thumbnail rendering. ffmpeg/ffprobe are present and the skill's own reference files (description template, thumbnail template) exist next to SKILL.md, so the local editing steps are feasible, but the pipeline's defining endpoints (ingest from the conferencing account and publish to the video account) cannot be exercised. Per the safety rules I stopped at the first inherent account requirement rather than fabricating a source recording or stubbing the missing uploader/download programs.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and both reference files under the skill folder (references/description-template.md, references/thumbnail-template.html present). `which ffmpeg ffprobe` -> /usr/bin/ffmpeg, /usr/bin/ffprobe (present). Checked prerequisite locations: the home conferencing-skill scripts directory, the uploader project directory, and the intro-animation out/ path all return 'No such file or directory'; ~/.claude/skills/ contains only session-start-hook and synced, not the zoom/youtube/video-youtube-upload skills the pipeline builds on. `which google-chrome chromium chromium-browser` found no browser for thumbnail rendering. Attempting the Step-1 bundled recordings-listing command (which reads the conferencing OAuth credential store) was additionally denied by the runtime's credential-exploration guard. No source recording obtainable and no permitted path to a public upload, so the end-to-end deliverable could not be produced or verified.
